hints.title: Optimal Sequence of Paste Operations
hints.text: A multiplier sequence consists of Select All, Copy, followed by one or more Pastes, which multiplies previously accumulated characters.

hints.title: Looking Back Three or More Keystrokes
hints.text: To copy at step j and paste up to step i requires at least 3 keystrokes. For each step i, consider copying what was at step j and pasting i - j - 1 times.

hints.title: One-Dimensional Tabulation
hints.text: Set dp[i] = i initially. For i from 1 to n, and j from 3 to i-1, update dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[i - j] * (j - 1)). Return dp[n].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N^2) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute force branching across 4 operations takes exponential O(4^N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tabulating best count for each step i avoids recalculating overlapping subproblems.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should note that copying requires 2 keystrokes (select and copy), so multiplication only beats plain typing for j >= 3.
